## 改动摘要 / Summary

Explain the user-visible outcome and why this change is needed.

## 影响面 / Impact

List affected modules, interfaces, permissions, migrations or configuration.
State compatibility and data-handling changes where applicable.

## 验证证据 / Validation

List the commands actually run, their results, and paths not covered.
Keep tests and current repository gates intact; do not claim an unrun check passed.
